## Glossary

**auto-approval**  
hivemind install allows every tool except hivemind_reset in ~/.claude/settings.json.

**bun run mcp**  
Script that starts the stdio server (the default, local mode).

**bun run mcp:http**  
Script that starts the HTTP server; needs HIVEMIND_API_TOKEN.

**createMcpServer**  
Builds the MCP Server named 'hivemind' with list-tools and call-tool handlers wired to core.ts.

**executeToolByName**  
Dispatches a tool name plus args to its executeX function; throws 'Unknown tool: <name>'.

**/health**  
Unauthenticated GET returning {ok, mode:'network', sessions}.

**hivemind-mcp**  
Package bin for the stdio server (dist/mcp/server.js); needs Bun.

**hivemind_* tools**  
setup, register, emit, query, status, events, claim_task, start_task, complete_task, worktree_cleanup, reset.

**HIVEMIND_API_TOKEN**  
Bearer token required on every /mcp request; also needed by the remote SessionStart path.

**HIVEMIND_NETWORK_MODE**  
Liveness toggle; startHttpMcpServer sets it to 1 when unset.

**HIVEMIND_TOOL_DEFS**  
Array in src/mcp/core.ts of all 11 tool definitions both servers return from list-tools.

**/mcp**  
The bearer-authenticated streamable-HTTP MCP endpoint.

**mcp-session-id**  
Header naming an MCP session; each session gets its own transport and server.

**mcp-tools**  
Class: defining and dispatching the hivemind_* MCP tools in src/mcp/core.ts and src/mcp/tools/.

**mcp-transports**  
Class: serving the tools over stdio (src/mcp/server.ts) or streamable HTTP (src/mcp/httpServer.ts).

**network mode**  
One shared hivemind over HTTP; agents tracked by last_seen_at leases instead of PIDs.

**PORT**  
HTTP port for network mode, default 8787; hostname defaults to 0.0.0.0.

**Server name 'hivemind'**  
The MCP server identity createMcpServer declares.

**startHttpMcpServer**  
startHttpMcpServer({port, hostname}): the Bun.serve streamable-HTTP MCP server.

**stdio server**  
src/mcp/server.ts: createMcpServer over a stdio transport; local mode, PID liveness.

**tool def + executeX**  
Each src/mcp/tools/ file exports a tool definition, an executeX function and its input/result types.

## 1. What this Warden covers

How hivemind's 11 hivemind_* tools are defined once in src/mcp/core.ts and served to Claude Code sessions, over stdio for local mode or over bearer-authenticated streamable HTTP for network mode.

## 2. The domain

Each tool is a file in src/mcp/tools/ exporting a tool def and an executeX function. src/mcp/core.ts gathers the defs in HIVEMIND_TOOL_DEFS, maps names to executors for executeToolByName (which throws 'Unknown tool: <name>'), and createMcpServer builds the MCP Server named 'hivemind' whose list-tools answers with HIVEMIND_TOOL_DEFS and whose call-tool goes through executeToolByName. A new tool goes in both places in core.ts; transports never register their own handlers, so stdio and HTTP always serve the same 11 tools. hivemind install auto-approves every tool except hivemind_reset.

Transports wrap createMcpServer. src/mcp/server.ts is the stdio server (bun run mcp, the hivemind-mcp bin): local mode with PID liveness, one machine. startHttpMcpServer in src/mcp/httpServer.ts (bun run mcp:http) is network mode: Bun.serve on PORT (default 8787) at 0.0.0.0, unauthenticated GET /health returning {ok, mode:'network', sessions}, /mcp requiring Authorization: Bearer <HIVEMIND_API_TOKEN> (the server refuses to start without the token), one streamable HTTP transport per mcp-session-id, and HIVEMIND_NETWORK_MODE=1 set if unset, which switches agents to lease liveness (agents-and-liveness). Choose stdio for sessions on one machine; choose HTTP when isolated containers must share one hivemind. Hivemind runs on Bun only.

What a tool does belongs to its domain region: hivemind_register and hivemind_status to agents-and-liveness; hivemind_emit, hivemind_query and hivemind_events to event-log; the claim/start/complete task tools to plans-and-tasks; hivemind_worktree_cleanup to git-and-worktrees; hivemind_setup and hivemind_reset to storage-and-primitives. Not here: tool behaviour (those regions), the SessionStart hook, its remote path and install/init (claude-code-integration), leases, the coordinator and the dead-agent sweep (agents-and-liveness).

**Source:** `ARCHITECTURE.md` § Overview (in "Hivemind Architecture")

#### Overview

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                      Claude Sessions                         │
├─────────────┬─────────────┬─────────────┬─────────────┬─────┤
│   Agent 1   │   Agent 2   │   Agent 3   │   Agent N   │ ... │
│  (PID 1234) │  (PID 5678) │  (PID 9012) │             │     │
└──────┬──────┴──────┬──────┴──────┬──────┴─────────────┴─────┘
       │             │             │
       ▼             ▼             ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│        MCP Server (stdio, or HTTP in network mode)           │
│  hivemind_register, hivemind_emit, hivemind_query, etc.     │
└─────────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────┘
                          │
                          ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    SQLite Database                           │
│  ~/.hivemind/claude_hivemind_{project}/hivemind.db          │
├─────────────┬───────────┬──────────┬──────────┬─────────────┤
│   agents    │  events   │  plans   │  tasks   │  worktrees  │
└─────────────┴───────────┴──────────┴──────────┴─────────────┘
                          ▲
                          │
┌─────────────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────┐
│                    Coordinator (singleton)                   │
│  - Checks agent PIDs (local) or leases (network)             │
│  - Marks dead agents, runs the plan watcher                  │
│  - Runs indefinitely per project                            │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

<!-- unit doc:ARCHITECTURE.md#core-components -->
**Source:** `ARCHITECTURE.md` § Core Components (in "Hivemind Architecture")

#### Core Components

##### 1. SessionStart Hook (`src/hooks/sessionStart.ts`)
- Runs when Claude starts, resumes or compacts (matchers `startup`, `resume`, `compact`)
- Reads the hook's stdin JSON (`session_id`, `cwd`); the project is the git repo name
- Locally: registers the agent with `process.ppid` (Claude's PID) through `executeRegister`, then reads `executeStatus`
- With `HIVEMIND_REMOTE_URL` set (needs `HIVEMIND_API_TOKEN`): calls `hivemind_register` and `hivemind_status` on the remote MCP server instead
- An optional label comes from `CLAUDE_AGENT_LABEL`
- Outputs agent info to Claude's context
- Does not start the coordinator (see below)

##### 2. Coordinator (`src/coordinator/index.ts`)
- Singleton per project (`coordinator.pid` and `coordinator.lock` in the project data dir)
- Started as a detached `bun` process by `ensureCoordinator` (`src/coordinator/spawn.ts`), which `hivemind_emit` calls on every emit; nothing else starts it
- Sweeps every 30 seconds
- Local mode: checks if agent PIDs are alive via `process.kill(pid, 0)`, with a 1-minute grace period for new agents; agents without a PID are left alone
- Network mode: marks agents whose lease expired
- Starts the plan watcher
- Runs indefinitely

##### 3. MCP Tools (`src/mcp/tools/`)
Defined once in `src/mcp/core.ts` (`HIVEMIND_TOOL_DEFS`, `executeToolByName`, `createMcpServer`) and served over stdio (`src/mcp/server.ts`) or HTTP (`src/mcp/httpServer.ts`).

- `hivemind_setup` - Initialize project database
- `hivemind_register` - Register agent (reconnects by session ID, then PID)
- `hivemind_emit` - Emit events for other agents
- `hivemind_query` - Query events (by since, plan, agent or branch)
- `hivemind_status` - Get hivemind status
- `hivemind_events` - Get recent events
- `hivemind_claim_task`, `hivemind_start_task`, `hivemind_complete_task` - Task workflow
- `hivemind_worktree_cleanup` - Find and clean up stale worktrees
- `hivemind_reset` - Reset database (delete and recreate schema)

##### 4. HTTP Server (`src/mcp/httpServer.ts`)
- `bun run mcp:http`; listens on `PORT` (default 8787), hostname `0.0.0.0`
- `GET /health` returns `{ ok, mode: 'network', sessions }`
- `/mcp` requires `Authorization: Bearer <HIVEMIND_API_TOKEN>`; each MCP session (`mcp-session-id`) gets its own streamable HTTP transport

##### 5. Database Schema

**agents** - Claude sessions
```sql
id, hex, label, status, pid, session_id, last_seen_at,
current_plan_id, current_task_id, worktree_id,
context_summary, created_at
```

**events** - Communication log
```sql
id, hex, seq, timestamp, agent_id, plan_id, task_id,
worktree_id, branch, event_type, content, metadata
```

**plans** - High-level work items
```sql
id, hex, label, title, description, status, branch,
worktree_id, claude_session_id, created_at, created_by
```

**tasks** - Granular work items within plans
```sql
id, plan_hex, seq, label, plan_id, title, description,
status, branch, worktree_id, claimed_by, claimed_at,
completed_at, outcome, parent_task_id
```

**worktrees** - Git worktrees
```sql
id, hex, label, path, branch, commit_hash, is_main,
status, created_at, last_seen
```

#### Tools

| Tool | Description | Auto |
|------|-------------|------|
| `hivemind_status` | Get status (agents, plans, events) | ✓ |
| `hivemind_events` | Get recent events | ✓ |
| `hivemind_query` | Query events with filters | ✓ |
| `hivemind_claim_task` | Claim a task | ✓ |
| `hivemind_start_task` | Mark task in progress | ✓ |
| `hivemind_complete_task` | Mark task done | ✓ |
| `hivemind_worktree_cleanup` | Clean up stale worktrees | ✓ |
| `hivemind_setup` | Initialize project | ✓ |
| `hivemind_register` | Register this agent | ✓ |
| `hivemind_emit` | Emit event to log | ✓ |
| `hivemind_reset` | Reset database | ✗ |

Tools marked ✓ are auto-approved after `./setup.sh`. Tools marked ✗ require confirmation.

<!-- unit doc:README.md#server-modes -->
**Source:** `README.md` § Server Modes (in "Hivemind")

#### Server Modes

##### Local mode (default, stdio)

Use this for single-machine/local Claude sessions:

```bash
bun run mcp
```

This preserves the existing MCP stdio behavior and local PID-based lifecycle.

##### Network mode (shared MCP over HTTP)

Use this when multiple containers/processes need to share one hivemind:

```bash
HIVEMIND_API_TOKEN=replace-me \
PORT=8787 \
bun run mcp:http
```

The HTTP endpoint is:

```text
http://0.0.0.0:$PORT/mcp
```

Network mode requires:
- `Authorization: Bearer <HIVEMIND_API_TOKEN>` on MCP HTTP requests
- Lease/heartbeat lifecycle (`last_seen_at`) with TTL sweeping (no PID liveness reliance)

<!-- unit doc:README.md#environment-variables -->
**Source:** `README.md` § Environment Variables (in "Hivemind")

#### Environment Variables

- `HIVEMIND_API_TOKEN`: required for `bun run mcp:http`
- `PORT`: HTTP port for network mode (default `8787`)
- `HIVEMIND_REMOTE_URL`: when set in hook/agent environments, session-start register/status calls go to remote MCP instead of local DB logic
- `HIVEMIND_AGENT_LEASE_TTL_SECONDS`: lease TTL for stale-agent sweep in network mode (default `180`)
- `HIVEMIND_NETWORK_MODE`: liveness mode toggle (`1/true` enables lease-based mode). `mcp:http` enables this automatically.
- `HIVEMIND_BASE`: base directory for project DB/state (defaults to `~/.hivemind`)
- `CLAUDE_AGENT_LABEL`: optional label the session-start hook gives the agent (it becomes part of the agent ID)
